title: Crash on sensor start
body:
OnePlus 7pro
Android 10
Latest 3 nightly,s 

App crashes on sensor start, perfectly repeatable on every type of sensor input Oop2 or not doesn't seem to matter. Erasing app memory clears the problem.

comments.body: Can you post the error messages you are getting and the xDrip Event Log after the app "crashes"? What does "Oop2" mean? More information needed.

Hi and Merry Christmas

Oop2 is the external algorithm for libre2 sensors.
I,ll try and post a error log later. Went back to te G6 and killed the
Libre2 because of skin/tissue issues. Problem is that when the app dies the
only solution is to reinstall or erase memory.

Latest release works perfectly with the Dexcom G6 by the way.. It actually
automatically started the sensor on takeover.

Thanks,

Regards Jelmer

Dexcom g6 sensor start let's xdrip 23 december crash. Going back to 27 November solved the problem for me. Same issue.

Problem appears to be in the Dutch translation. Being pointed to this by a fellow Dutch Xdrip user it seems native English don't have the problem. Simply setting the slider to English seems to be enough. 
![Screenshot_20210101-112454](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51903932/103437260-c35bb400-4c25-11eb-9ae1-a19b0258b1da.jpg)
At what point exactly do you get the crash? When the Sensor Start menu item is used or after readings start?

Literally the moment you press start sensor. It's perfectly repeatable with every sensor type. Only a automatic G6 start (great new feature) didn't cause the problem. 
As said above switch to English and nothing seems wrong
Can you try the latest nightly and let me know if that resolves the issue. Many thanks

![Screenshot_20210103_172350_com eveningoutpost dexdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/40701484/103483603-a8856d00-4de8-11eb-9540-b44b89591d70.jpg)
Looks like the crash issue has been resolved
@jamorham great work mate all appears to be well again 👍
